steps.comment: Firstfield Meadow, walked: in off the rainbow, Fizz's HEY, a sign she gets to first, Old Hollis's stick (and giving it back), the chest with Nix watching, and Dilys's sheep - with the 'But thou must' loop taken once. Norbert and the graduation are firstfield_graduation, because the battle alone is a few minutes headless.

steps.label: Fizz has not said HEY
walking onto the foot of the rainbow starts the meadow's door
the rainbow ends in Firstfield Meadow
arriving just inside the trees
Fizz is directly in front of you before you have taken a step
HEY has been said
and she has zipped off to the graduation lawn
HEY! LISTEN! is a trope
standing under the gate sign, facing it
Fizz is between you and the sign
the sign has been read, once
and Fizz is home again
reading it again is a second sign read, and a different Fizz line
but only the first read is a trope

steps.comment: Station one. Round by the path: the sign blocks column 13.

steps.label: walked to Old Hollis along the west path
the action button reaches Old Hollis
a stick, and station one done
the first stick in forty-one years has come back, and Nell sends a straighter one
at the chest, in its ring of flowers
the action button reaches the chest
a potion, a note, and station two done
at Dilys, at the gate of her empty pen
and her sheep are pigs

steps.comment: The first Yes/No is answered No by a shim rather than {choose}, whose timing against the text printing is guesswork; every one after it takes the default, Yes.
steps.eval: window._yn = 0; const o = Game_Interpreter.prototype.setupChoices; Game_Interpreter.prototype.setupChoices = function (p) { if (p[0][1] === 'No' && p[0].length === 2) { p = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(p)); p[2] = ++window._yn === 1 ? 1 : 0; } return o.call(this, p); }

steps.label: No is not an answer Dilys has been given a line for: she asks again
the loop asks again, and yes gets the quest
'But thou must' is a trope (after HEY, the sign, the stick and the chest)
three sheep found, where they were
Dilys pays out a Hi-Potion and station three is done
six tropes in the meadow so far
